name: agile-mods
description: Claude Mods for the agile-skills loop: /agile-board opens the agile console pane (board with burnup and a Monte Carlo done-by forecast, ticket and PR flow, aging WIP and PR overlap, drain passes with cost, cache hit rate and the loop's agents, guards and receipts, links), read live from gh, the Jira MCP and the engine rather than from the model's answers, with a status-line entry (spend per hour and per merged PR, the 85% date) and an alert row above the prompt; guards that check GitHub at merge time (pinned live head, green CI on it, every file read by a reviewer), enforce agent tool grants, cap the merge train's fix rounds, stop new build work at an optional budget, and refuse pushes to main and force pushes inside the loop; /receipts checks agent receipts against the contract; retro counts for agile-15. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or later.

autoOpen.title: Open the console when a drain starts
autoOpen.description: Opens the agile console pane, unfocused, when agile-sprint-drain starts. It appears only in a terminal at least 144 columns wide; /agile-board opens it at any width.

budgetUsd.title: Loop budget in USD
budgetUsd.description: Once a loop run has spent this much, the guards refuse build work: open PRs still merge, then the loop stops and reports BUDGET. 0 is no budget.
